newsitem.title: USA: Tennessee capital investment hits eight-year high.
newsitem.headline: Tennessee capital investment hits eight-year high.

text.p: Tennessee recorded its highest level of intended capital investment in eight years during the first half of 1997, the state Department of Economic and Community Devlopment said Wednesday.

During the first six months of the year, plans were announced for 278 manufacturing plants, headquarters, distribution centers and other projects totalling $1.9 billion, Ray Dickerson, department director of research, said. The total was the highest since the first half of 1989.
The projects are expected to add 11,368 jobs, the biggest job gain since the first half of 1992.
The figures represent a 34 percent increase in investment and a 25 percent increase in new jobs over the same period last year.
Among the projects were a $178 million air courier service facility in Memphis and a $150 million expansion by E.I duPont DeNemours in Chattanooga.
